_comment: High-security: fastest detection the method allows. Run: ContAuth.exe --config agent-config.high-security.json

_notes.detection: 3 s windows + lock on the FIRST HIGH window => catches an impostor in ~3-6 seconds.
_notes.cost: Locking on one bad window means MORE false locks for the real user. That is the speed/false-alarm tradeoff; there is no way around it.
_notes.enrollment: Kept at 20 windows (~60 s) on purpose: because it locks on a single bad window, the profile must be steady or you will lock yourself out often.
_notes.bots_and_cookies: Deterministic threats (scripted input, stolen-cookie signals) already lock instantly, in any config.
